decision.rationale: The UBC Faculty of Medicine MD undergraduate education homepage presents its distributed academic program, explicitly including Vancouver-Fraser alongside Southern, Northern and Island programs. Public program information is useful and not exclusively Okanagan-serving. Academic program content is the default, with explicit spotlight news and student narratives classified separately.

rules.rationale: The homepage spotlight announces a newly launched regional training program.
The homepage features narratives about individual students and rural training experiences.

fallback.rationale: The host describes UBC MD undergraduate education and its distributed medical degree program, including Vancouver-Fraser.
